global: A bowl of spicy ramen with rich, reddish broth and visible chashu pork and nori seaweed. Served in a blue-and-white patterned bowl, it rests on a dark wooden table under warm, ambient lighting.

regions.background: Dark brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections on its smooth surface.
regions.bowl: The ceramic ramen bowl has a blue and white wave pattern with a slightly worn, glazed rim.
regions.soup: Spicy ramen broth with noodles, green onions, bean sprouts, and a large white meat slice, all submerged in rich, reddish-brown liquid.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly glossy surface with visible grainy details.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is a round, seared slice with a golden-brown crust, tender-looking interior, and visible fat marbling.
